main_text.l: Sexto, idolum, Ose.4.12. Septimo, vis arcana creaturis Creatore prout & quantumlibet concessa, Leui.26.26. Ez 4.16. & 5.16. & 14.16.]
BALA ciuitas, quæ & Segor, Gen.14.2. siue Thohar: quæ pro cibus Loth reseruata fuit: Gen.19.20. [nomé viri, 1.Par.5. & 7.13.]
BALA, ancilla Rachel, Gene.29.v.28.29. ea concubina à Rachele Iacobo datur, 30.3. parit Dan, v.5. 6. & Nephtali, v. 8. Ruben incestu eam polluit, 35.22. eius filij, v.25.

BALAAM, filius Beor ariolus, Numer. 22.5. vocatus vt maledicer Israelitis, benedicit, Num.23. 11. Deut.23.v.4.5. Ie 24.v.9.10. Nehem.13.2. Christi aduentum prædicit, Num. 24.17. doctrina Balaam, Apoc.2.14. impietas, Mich.6.5. iniquissima, 2.Pet.2.15. gladio occiditur, Nu.31.8. [Balaam ciuitas, 1.Par.6.70. (Bileam, i.confusus populus.)
BALAC, Rex Moab, timens Israelitas, Balaam vt eis maledicere accesfit, Numer. 22. v. 2.3.4.5.6. Iof.24.9. Vide Iudic.11. Mich.6.5. Apoc.2.14. (i.exterminans.)
BALAENA, Cete, Iob. 40.20. est à Deo, Gen.1.21. Pf.104.25. (Vide Leuiathan, & Cetus.)
BALDAD Suhites, amicus Iob, cum duobus aliis amicis Iob inuisit, Iob.2.11. eius contra Iob disputatio, 8.v.1.2.3.4.& v.1.2.3. pro quo Iob orauit, cap.42.8.
BALTASAR, Rex Babylonis, conuiuium celebrat, Danielis videt visionem horrendam, v. 5. turbatur ea, v 6.9. visionem exponit Daniel, v.17, &c. occiditur, & regnum eius transfertur ad Darium, v 30.
[BALTASAR, nomen Danieli in Babylone impositum, Dan. 1.7. & 2.26. & 4.5.&c. & 5 12. & 10.1.]
BANAIAS, filius Ioiadæ, vir fortissimus, 2.Sam.23.20. Dauid satellitio præpositus, v.23. Dux Cerethi & Pelethi, 20. Ioabum iussu Salomonis occidit, 1.Regum 2. v.29.31. (. ædificator domini.)

BAPTISMVS, est sacramentum institutum à Christo in noui Testamento, quo abluimur aqua, in nomine Patris, Filij, Spiritus sancti, ad significandum nos recipi in gratiam Patre, propter sanguinem Christi pro nobis effusum, & generari ipsius spiritu ad vitæ nouitatem.
BAPTISMA, pro cruce Christi, & afflictionibus, Matthæi
